description: The boards of one connected Pinterest account, read from Pinterest now: each board’s id and name, and which one its pins go to (chosen). To pin a post somewhere else, name a board in the draft’s options.board. Changes nothing.

accountId.description: A Pinterest account id from accounts_list.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

name: boards_list
title: List Pinterest boards
